users.title: Users
users.activeHint: Deactivating it signs out all its sessions; it can be reactivated later. Users are never deleted.
users.usernameRule: 3 to 64 characters: letters, digits, full stop, hyphen or underscore
users.resetPasswordHint: Leave it empty to keep the current one. If you change it, their sessions are signed out and the lock is removed.
users.roleHint: Tenant role with its administration permissions.
users.instanceAdminHint: Tenants, locations, settings, AI and workers, and acting in any tenant.
users.tenantHint: Moving them removes their projects and sessions, and gives them the “User” role.

intro.all: Open sessions of all users. Revoking one ends that session immediately.
intro.own: Your open sessions in other browsers or devices. Revoking one ends it immediately.

sessions.confirmBody: The session of {{username}} from {{ip}} will be ended.
sessions.confirmCurrent: This is your current session: you will have to sign in again.

purge.title: Delete audit entries by date
purge.intro: Permanently deletes this tenant's audit entries between two dates (UTC). Today's entries cannot be deleted, and the deletion itself is recorded in the audit log. Earlier backups still keep them.
purge.untilHint: Today at the latest: today's entries are not deleted.
purge.invalidRange: The start date must be before the end date, and the end date cannot be later than today.
purge.confirm: To confirm, type the number of entries ({{count}})

folders.emptyMounts: There are no folders mounted in /mnt. Mount them in docker compose (in web and worker) and restart; see the “Locations” guide.
folders.nothingSelected: You have not chosen a folder yet.

locations.title: Locations
locations.intro: Document folders the application can use. Open one to browse its folders.
locations.introAdmin: Folders mounted under /mnt that the application can use as a source or destination. Network folders are mounted on the server (see the “Mounting network folders” guide).
locations.empty: There are no locations yet. Ask an administrator to register one.
locations.emptyAdmin: There are no locations yet. Register the first one with “New location”.
locations.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from the application. The folder and its documents are not touched.

inUse.title: The location is in use
inUse.active_one: This active project uses it. Delete it before deleting the location:
inUse.active_other: These {{count}} active projects use it. Delete them before deleting the location:

form.folderHint: Browse /mnt and click “Choose this folder”. It cannot be changed later.
form.pathFixed: Cannot be changed: to use another folder, register a new location.

patterns.title: Names that are not scanned
patterns.intro: Files and folders with these names are not scanned in any project that reads from this location.
patterns.warning: Affects all projects in the location. Anything already converted that matches is kept, but “Force reconversion” deletes it.
patterns.label: Patterns (one per line)
patterns.examples: Wildcards * and ?, case-insensitive, no “/” or “\”, up to 30 of 64 characters. Examples: ~$*, @eaDir, #recycle, $RECYCLE.BIN, System Volume Information.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Values that apply without a restart. If you do not change them here, the server's DOW_* variables or the defaults apply.
settings.defaultIs: Without a change it would be {{value}}

session_idle_minutes.label: Maximum session inactivity (min)
session_idle_minutes.hint: The session ends after this long without activity.

session_absolute_hours.label: Maximum session duration (h)
session_absolute_hours.hint: From when it starts, even if there is activity.

login_max_attempts.label: Failed attempts before lockout
login_max_attempts.hint: Consecutive failures that lock the account.

login_lockout_minutes.label: Lockout duration (min)
login_lockout_minutes.hint: How long the account stays locked.

location_probe_timeout_seconds.label: Maximum check time (s)
location_probe_timeout_seconds.hint: For location probes and listings; avoids waiting on hung mounts.

location_latency_degraded_ms.label: Latency for “degraded” (ms)
location_latency_degraded_ms.hint: Above this, the location is marked as degraded.

location_min_free_gb.label: Minimum free space (GB)
location_min_free_gb.hint: Below this, the location is marked as degraded; 0 = not checked.

location_probe_interval_minutes.label: Periodic location probe (min)
location_probe_interval_minutes.hint: How often the worker checks the locations; 0 = never.

run_retention_days.label: Run retention (days)
run_retention_days.hint: After this period, the files of finished runs are deleted (the history is kept).

user_quota_mb.label: File quota per user (MB)
user_quota_mb.hint: Artefact space per user in the workspace; 0 = unlimited.

ai_timeout_seconds.label: Maximum time per AI request (s)
ai_timeout_seconds.hint: Each classify, describe and embeddings request (context and duplicates) (120 s by default; with a local 14B model, some classifications take more than 30 s). The usage panel waits at most 10 s (5–300).

ai_draft_timeout_seconds.label: Maximum time for long-running tasks (s)
ai_draft_timeout_seconds.hint: Long-running tasks: the manifest draft request and each agent call; a local model may take minutes (5–900).

ai_draft_retries.label: Retries for long-running tasks
ai_draft_retries.hint: On a connection failure or timeout (0–5). With 0, a request that does not respond fails without being retried.

ai_max_documents_per_run.label: Documents with AI per run
ai_max_documents_per_run.hint: Maximum number of documents a context build can send to the AI, per task (classify and describe each count separately). A feature with its own maximum in “Models by feature” uses the lower one.

settings.aiMoved: AI timeouts, retries and limits are now in

capabilities.title: Instance capabilities
capabilities.pending: Checking… (the worker takes a minute the first time)
capabilities.noWorkerBody: Capabilities are published by the worker; the last known data is shown, if any.

workers.title: Workers
workers.intro: Workers are the processes that do the heavy lifting: scanning, converting, OCR, duplicates and AI. Each one serves its queues (cpu or gpu) and runs as many runs at once as it has slots; the rest wait in the queue.
workers.empty: No workers registered. Without a worker, runs wait in the queue.
workers.idHelp: Worker container and process (changes when it restarts).
workers.idleHelp: Connected with no runs: it will take the next one from its queue.
workers.staleHelp: No signal for more than a minute: it is stopped or down. If it had runs, they are closed as failed when it comes back.
workers.memoryPeakHelp: The peak counts from when the container started. If it nears the limit, raise DOW_WORKER_MEM_LIMIT or lower DOW_SCAN_RECYCLE_DOCUMENTS.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Each project reads from a source location and writes its results to its own folder in a destination location.
projects.empty: You are not a member of any project yet. Create one or ask its owner to invite you.

form.destinationHint: Destination locations with read and write access.
form.noLocations: No locations available: ask an administrator to register them.
form.noSources: Browse and click “Choose this folder” to add folders.
form.sourceRequired: Add at least one source folder
form.parentHint: Choose the folder that will contain it (the root if you choose none).
form.emptyHint: It must be empty: the project will own it and may empty or delete it.
form.newFolderHint: No / \ : * ? " < > |; it must not already exist.
form.rootNotAllowed: The location root cannot be the project folder: open an empty subfolder or choose “Create a new folder”.

edit.title: Edit project
edit.renameHint: Changing the name does not rename the output folder.
edit.captureOwner: Store the owner of each file
edit.captureOwnerHint: This is personal data: only project owners can see it. It applies from the next scan, and when disabled that scan removes it from the cache.

members.title: Members
members.inviteHint: Type at least two letters of the username or name.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.intro: These operations move or delete files. You will first see a preview with no changes and then have to type the project name.
danger.busy: A run is in progress: wait for it to finish.
danger.previewResult: This is what will be done:

history_clear.title: Clear the history of “{{name}}”
history_clear.body: The outputs (Markdown, JSON, images, duplicates), the taxonomy manifest and the project cache are deleted. The project and its members are kept; the manifest can be restored from “Versions”.

project_move.title: Move the outputs of “{{name}}”
project_move.body: The output folder is moved to a new folder in the chosen destination. Between different locations it is copied and then the original is deleted.

project_delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”
project_delete.body: The project disappears from the list; its run history is kept. The cache is always deleted.
project_delete.outputsHint: If you leave this unticked, the outputs stay in the destination.

danger.previewReady: Preview ready: check the result and type the project name.

scan_force.title: Force reconversion of “{{name}}”
scan_force.body: The cache is emptied and every document in every folder is converted again. Outputs of documents no longer in the source are deleted.
scan_force.excludedBody: They were already converted but are now left out of the scan by an excluded subfolder or a source location pattern. Forcing deletes their output and their cache entry. If this is not what you want, cancel and remove the exclusion or the pattern.

context_delete.title: Delete the context of “{{name}}”
context_delete.body: The reorganised folder, the site, context.json and domains/ are deleted from the project folder. Conversions, originals, the taxonomy manifest and the context history are kept.

ai.title: Project context and AI
ai.redactHelp: Before sending text to the AI and publishing the context site, any passwords, tokens and keys found are replaced with “REDACTED”. Enabled by default. It applies from the next build.
ai.redactOff: Disabled: any credentials in the documents are sent as they are to the AI and published on the site.
ai.readOnly: The destination is read-only: this setting cannot be changed.
ai.confirm: Passwords, tokens and keys in the documents will be sent as they are to the AI service and will appear on the context site. Only do this if the AI service and the site are trusted with that data.
ai.versionsHelp: Documents with a version marker in the name (“v1.2”, “rev2”, “version 3”…) in the same folder. It applies from the next build.
ai.versionsAcross: Group versions even if the format changes
ai.versionsAcrossHelp: “Manual_v2.docx” and “Manual_v3.pdf” count as versions of the same document, and the same version in several formats is current as a whole. Only enable this if in this project the same name in another format is the same document (not, for example, data in Excel and its report in PDF).

versionModes.mark: Mark the current one (all go into the context)
versionModes.current_only: Current only (older ones are left out)

ai.semanticHelp: Before the AI, fills empty axes by comparing each document with the description of each value (“Embeddings (semantic)” row in “Models by feature”). The values carry the “Semantic” tag. Document text is sent to the embeddings service; the index is stored in the project folder.
ai.thresholdHelp: Between 0 and 1 (default 0.75): the higher it is, the fewer and more reliable the values.
ai.semanticNotConfigured: AI is not configured for “Embeddings (semantic)”: the build will run without semantics until an administrator configures it in AI › Settings.

runs.title: Runs
runs.intro: Run history for your projects, newest first. Runs keep going even if you close the tab.
runs.queuedHint: Queued: it will start when a worker is free.
runs.cancelBody: It will stop at the next safe point; work already done is kept.
runs.noArtifacts: This run did not leave any files.
runs.purged: The files were deleted when the retention period expired.

result.leftovers: Items that could not be deleted
result.io_errors: Files that could not be read
result.orphaned: Outputs to be deleted (the document is gone)
result.stale_cache: In the cache but no longer in the source
result.failed: Files that could not be moved or copied

scope.unclassified: What the rules do not classify

ai.scope: What was sent to the AI

result.excluded: Excluded items to be deleted (excluded subfolder or pattern)
result.excluded_cached: Cached documents excluded from the scan
result.content_not_compared: Not compared by content (not converted or almost empty)
result.reused: Chunks taken from the index (no model call)

errors.internal: Internal error while running the operation.
errors.timeout: It exceeded the maximum time; work done up to that point was saved.
errors.spawn_failed: The operation could not be started.
errors.folder_replaced: The outputs folder is no longer the registered one; it has not been touched.
errors.option_unavailable: The worker cannot handle one of the scan options.
errors.folder_not_saved: A folder is no longer a source folder of the project.
errors.folder_missing: The folder no longer exists in the source.
errors.scan_failed: doc_organize could not complete the scan.
errors.ai_not_configured: The AI for this operation is no longer configured.
errors.ai_auth: The AI service rejected the key.
errors.ai_connection: Could not connect to the AI service.
errors.ai_timeout: The AI service did not respond in time.
errors.ai_error: The AI service returned an error.
errors.no_converted_documents: The project has no converted documents.
errors.out_of_memory: The worker ran out of memory. A scan resumes where it left off when you run it again.

runs.segments_other: The scan ran in {{count}} segments: each segment is a new process, so memory does not run out on long scans.

continue.title: Continue the scan
continue.body: Everything converted before it stopped is saved in the cache: a new scan with the same options only converts what is left.
continue.busy: Another operation is running in the project.

notify.title: {{operation}} has finished
notify.enable: Notify me in the browser when a run finishes

delivery.sha256: SHA-256 fingerprint of the ZIP (compare it with the one of the file received):

warning.export_site: Third-party content in the pages is neutralised, but the site contains the text of the documents: it may be confidential. Only deliver it to people who should see it.
warning.export_ai_bundle: The bundle contains the text of the documents and leaves the application: it may be confidential. Only upload it to authorised AI services.

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.estimated: ≈: estimated tokens (the proxy did not report them)

scan.title: Scan “{{name}}”
scan.intro: The scan finds the documents in the source folders and converts new or modified ones to Markdown and JSON. It is incremental: anything unchanged is not converted again. It keeps running even if you close the tab.
scan.readOnly: You can view the folders and the history; scanning requires the editor role.
scan.busy: A run is in progress in this project: wait for it to finish.

folders.title: Source folders in “{{location}}”
folders.addHint: Choose a folder in the source location. It cannot be inside another folder of the project or contain one: each document must always be converted to the same path.
folders.removeBody: The folder will no longer be scanned in this project. No files are deleted.
folders.usedTitle: This folder has already been scanned
folders.usedBody: Its outputs remain in the destination. To delete them, use “Force reconversion” (deletes the outputs of anything no longer in the folders) or “Clear history”.

use_ocr.label: OCR (recognise text in images and scanned PDFs)
use_ocr.help: Extracts the text from pages that are images. Without OCR, a scanned PDF comes out empty.
use_ocr.example: Example: a scanned invoice in PDF or a photo of a contract.

use_gpu.label: Use GPU for OCR
use_gpu.help: OCR uses EasyOCR on the GPU, much faster with thousands of scanned pages. The scan goes to the gpu queue.
use_gpu.example: Example: a historical archive of 50,000 scanned pages.
use_gpu.unavailable: There is no worker with a GPU and the EasyOCR models.

include_audio_video.label: Include audio and video
include_audio_video.help: Transcribes recordings with Whisper. It is slow: use it only if there are recordings worth including.
include_audio_video.example: Example: minutes of meetings recorded as .mp3 or .mp4.
include_audio_video.unavailable: This instance does not have Whisper and ffmpeg.

extract_images.label: Extract images
extract_images.help: Saves each document's images next to its Markdown (img/ folder).
extract_images.example: Example: plans or charts you want to consult separately.

use_picture_description.label: Describe images
use_picture_description.help: A vision model adds to the Markdown a description of each image in PDFs and of standalone images. It is slow.
use_picture_description.example: Example: site photos without text that you want to be able to search.
use_picture_description.unavailable: This instance does not have the vision model downloaded.

force.title: Force reconversion
force.intro: Clears the cache and converts all documents in all folders again with the options chosen above. Deletes the outputs of documents that are no longer in the source. You will see a preview first.

scan.capabilitiesError: The instance's capabilities could not be checked: the options that depend on them are disabled.
scan.capabilitiesLoading: Checking which options the instance supports…

exclusions.title: Excluded subfolders of {{folder}}
exclusions.hint: Tick the subfolders the scan should skip. Anything already converted from them is kept; “Force reconversion” deletes it. You can change this at any time: a scan in progress keeps the exclusions it had when it started.
exclusions.none: None: the whole folder is scanned.
exclusions.reconvertTitle: Anything you stop excluding goes back into the scan
exclusions.reconvertBody: If reconversion was forced since you excluded it, it will be converted again (including OCR); otherwise, anything already converted shows as “unchanged”.

scanErrors.title: Documents with errors
scanErrors.noScan: This project has not been scanned yet.
scanErrors.empty: All documents were converted without errors.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No documents yet: scan the project to see them here.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Each export is a run: when it finishes, download the file from its details. The ZIP contains everything converted; work out its size first if the project is large.

viewer.missing: This output no longer exists: the history may have been cleared or the project moved. Scan again.

contentSearch.title: Search the content
contentSearch.hint: Finds converted documents that contain all the words (ignoring case and accents).
contentSearch.noIndex: Search is not ready yet: it is prepared when a scan finishes, or with “Update search”.

documents.noMimeTypes: No types: documents scanned before 1.5 do not have one

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.intro: Find repeated documents across all source folders, review each group and apply only what you confirm. Searching does not touch any file.

search.title: Find duplicates
search.fuzzyHelp: As well as exact duplicates and versions, groups documents with similar names (review them one by one).
search.contentIntro: Compares the converted text of documents that were not grouped above. Use it after scanning and converting; documents without a conversion are not compared.
search.contentHelp: The same text in different files (for example a .docx and its .pdf). No AI.
search.semanticHelp: Rewritten versions, drafts or templates with different data, using the duplicates model.
search.semanticUnavailable: Requires the dedicated “Duplicates by content” model in AI › Settings (set up by an administrator).
search.semanticPrivacy: The full text of each compared document is sent to the duplicates model (with credentials redacted). Content groups are never applied automatically: review each one.

duplicates.noPreview: No duplicate search has been run in this project yet.
duplicates.previewNotReady: The duplicate search has not finished yet or failed.
duplicates.appliedAfter: Duplicates were applied on {{date}}, after this search: search again to see the current state.

apply.title: Apply duplicates
apply.mode: What to do with the ones not kept

modes.copy: Copy to the outputs “duplicados” folder (the source does not change)

apply.moveUnavailable: Owners only, and with a read-write source.
apply.nothing: No groups are marked to apply.
apply.moveWarning: The files will leave the source folder. They remain in “duplicados” and in the report, but anyone using the source will no longer see them.
apply.changed_one: {{count}} group has changed since the search and will not be applied.
apply.changed_other: {{count}} groups have changed since the search and will not be applied.
apply.tooMany: There are more than {{max}} groups: they cannot be applied at once. Filter by folder, apply in parts or search again without similar names.
apply.moveConversions: The conversion of each moved document goes with it to “duplicados/Conversión”: it is no longer included in the context. Rebuild the context afterwards.

similarity.semanticHint: Similarity of meaning according to the model (the lowest similarity between the documents in the group).
similarity.lexicalHint: Word-by-word text similarity. High: almost the same text. Low with high meaning: rewritten, or the same template with different data.
similarity.containedHint: One document in the group is contained in another (for example, an annex inside the full report).

compare.title: Compare documents
compare.intro: Converted text of each one, without formatting. Lines not present in the other are highlighted.
compare.notConverted: At least two converted documents in the group are needed to compare them.

context.title: Context
context.intro: Classifies the converted documents by domain, copies them to a reorganised project folder and generates a browsable site.
context.empty: The project has no context yet.
context.readOnly: The destination location is read-only: the context cannot be built or changed.

warnings.failed_one: {{count}} document could not be copied to the reorganised folder (e.g. it goes through a link).
warnings.failed_other: {{count}} documents could not be copied to the reorganised folder (e.g. they go through a link).
warnings.collisions_one: {{count}} document shares its name with another of the same domain and type: only one remains in the reorganised folder.
warnings.collisions_other: {{count}} documents share their name with another of the same domain and type: only one of each name remains in the reorganised folder.
warnings.noSite: The context has no built site (it was not requested or it failed: check the run).

build.title: Build the context

help.discover: One domain per folder: each document goes to the domain of the folder that contains it (those in the root go to the scanned folder's domain). It does not read the content.
help.domains: Only the domains you type are used (one axis).
help.template: The axes of a template: domain, material type and those that only tag.
help.manifest: The axes of the project manifest: domain, material type and those that only tag.

build.useTemplateAsManifestHint: Copies the template to the project manifest so you can adjust it. The template does not change.
build.domainsHelp: Type a domain and press Enter.
build.folderHelp: Inside the project folder. It is chosen only the first time.
build.folderFixed: It is rebuilt in the folder “{{folder}}” (to change it, delete the context first).

notReady.domains: Type at least one domain in the Taxonomy step.
notReady.template: Choose a template in the Taxonomy step.
notReady.unsavedManifest: The manifest has unsaved changes: save them before building.

build.folderLeftover: It is built in the folder “{{folder}}”, which was left half-finished: its contents are replaced.

history.title: History
history.intro: Each build of the context, most recent first. It is kept even if the context is deleted.
history.empty: There are no builds in the history yet.
history.tooLarge: The history is too large to show here: download it as Excel.
history.shown: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}: the Excel file has them all.
history.older: There are {{count}} older builds in the Excel file.

properties.author: Author: {{author}}
properties.byAi: Filled in by the AI because the document did not declare it

manifest.title: Taxonomy manifest
manifest.intro: This project's manifest: the domains and material types used for classification when building with this catalogue. You can write it, start from a template or ask the AI for a draft.
manifest.replaceBody: The manifest text is replaced with that of the template “{{name}}”. The saved manifest does not change until you save.
manifest.replaceBodyDraft: The manifest text is replaced with the AI draft. The saved manifest does not change until you save.
manifest.replaceBodyVersion: The manifest text is replaced with that of the version from {{date}}. The saved manifest does not change until you save.
manifest.copied: Copied from the template “{{name}}”. Review it and save it; then build.
manifest.restoreConfirm: The version from {{date}} is restored (before “{{action}}” by {{user}}). The current text is kept as a version and you can go back to it.
manifest.restoreEmpty: That version is “no manifest”: restoring it deletes the current manifest (it is kept as a version).
manifest.restoreLosesDraft: Unsaved changes in the editor will be lost.
manifest.versionsHint: The last {{limit}} are kept: what there was before each change.
manifest.versionsEmpty: There are no previous versions yet.
manifest.deleteConfirm: The project manifest is deleted. It can be restored from “Versions”.
manifest.contextStale: The context was built with the manifest from before this change: rebuild to apply it.
manifest.markdown: Markdown (YAML front matter with domains and material_types)
manifest.createHelp: Two ways to propose a manifest: a draft based on a sample of documents, or the agent, which improves it with changes checked against all the documents. Neither saves: the proposal goes to the editor.

site.title: Context site
site.isolated: The site is shown in isolation: its scripts cannot use your session or read application data.

ai.classify: Classify with AI what the rules leave unclassified
ai.classifyHelp: Only pending documents are sent, up to the per-run maximum in the settings. If the key is rejected, the service is no longer called.

notConfigured.classify: An administrator has to configure the AI for “Classify” in AI › Settings.
notConfigured.enrich: An administrator has to configure the AI for “Describe” in AI › Settings.
notConfigured.taxonomy_design: An administrator has to configure the AI for “Design the taxonomy” in AI › Settings.

ai.enrich: Complete description and keywords with AI
ai.enrichHelp: Only classified documents that do not declare them, with their own per-run maximum. What the document declares is not replaced.
ai.enrichEgress: The title and an excerpt of each classified document without a description or keywords will be sent to the configured AI service.
ai.egress: The title and an excerpt of each pending document will be sent to the configured AI service. Do not enable it with documents that must not leave your organisation.
ai.draftHelp: Sends the title and an excerpt of a sample of converted documents to the AI service and loads the proposal into the editor. It is not saved until you press “Save manifest”.
ai.draftLoadedBody: Review it and save it if it is useful.
ai.scope: What is sent to the AI

scopes.unclassified: What the rules do not classify

scopeHelp.unclassified: Only documents that the rules do not place in a folder (domain or material type).
scopeHelp.missing_axes: Also documents with an empty tag axis. Axes without rules (rules: false) are always empty after the rules: with them, all documents are sent, up to the maximum number of documents to classify per run. The AI only fills in what is empty: it never changes what the rules or a person decided.

unclassified.incomplete_artifactsHelp: Its Markdown or JSON is missing: scan the folder again.
unclassified.below_thresholdHelp: The rules did not reach the threshold and the AI did not assign a domain. “How it was classified” shows what they proposed.
unclassified.rebuild: Rebuild the context to see why they were not classified and their properties (context older than 1.6).

axes.notVerified: Quote not found in the text

frontMatter.ignored: These keys are not used for classification: {{keys}}.
frontMatter.implicit: These are read as axes: {{keys}}. You can declare them under “axes:” with their name and description.

profile.title: Project profile
profile.intro: What the model should know about this project: context, tie-break rules, glossary and examples. It is appended to the template's or manifest's profile (which goes in its body) and is only used by the AI, when classifying and describing.
profile.markdown: Profile (Markdown with the sections “## Contexto del proyecto”, “## Reglas de desempate”, “## Glosario” and “## Ejemplos”)
profile.placeholder:
## Contexto del proyecto
…

## Reglas de desempate
- …

## Glosario
- …

## Ejemplos
- “Document title” → domain, type
profile.noSections: The saved profile has none of the sections that doc_organize reads: nothing is sent to the model.
profile.previewNeedsCatalog: The preview needs a chosen template or the project manifest.
profile.previewHelp: What the model would receive when classifying a document, without calling it. Each document's excerpt goes in the last message.
profile.aiOnly: With this catalogue there is no taxonomy profile: this is everything the AI receives about the project.

manifestNotice.title: This project also has a separate profile
manifestNotice.body: With the manifest, the profile goes in its body. The separate profile (profile.md) is still appended after it when using the AI: copy it into the manifest and, once you have saved it, delete it to keep it in one place.

freshness.title: The context is out of date
freshness.staleSite: the site predates the latest build
freshness.checkedAt: Compared with the cache from the last scan ({{date}}). Rebuild to bring it up to date.
freshness.unknown_one: {{count}} document in the context has no fingerprint of its original (context older than 2.0): rebuild once to be able to tell whether it changes.
freshness.unknown_other: {{count}} documents in the context have no fingerprint of their original (context older than 2.0): rebuild once to be able to tell whether they change.

versions.title: Versions of a document
versions.intro: Groups of versions of the same document in the latest build. The current one is the highest version, unless a person chooses another.

mode.mark: Old versions are marked (all are in the context).
mode.current_only: Only the current version goes into the context.
mode.all: Versions are not taken into account.

versions.superseded_one: {{count}} old version left out of the context
versions.superseded_other: {{count}} old versions left out of the context
versions.oldTitle: There is a newer version of this document

delivery.title: Deliver the context
delivery.intro: For people without an account in the application or for an AI chat. Each delivery is a run: when it finishes, download the file from its details, where you will also see its SHA-256 fingerprint (recorded in the audit).
delivery.xlsxHelp: Documents with their axes and, on another sheet, how many there are of each value.
delivery.siteHelp: The context site to open from disk (double-click sitio/index.html), without requesting anything from third parties. Third-party content in the pages is neutralised and credentials are redacted according to the project setting. It does not change the site you see here.
delivery.llmsTxt: Add llms.txt (index for AI) to the site
delivery.bundleHelp: llms.txt, one text file per document with its record (axes, who classified it, version) and context.json, to upload to a chat project or an AI agent.
delivery.fullText: Add llms-full.txt (all the text in one file)
delivery.maxFileCharsHelp: Truncates each document's text (the truncation is flagged). Empty: no limit.
delivery.redactHelp: Only an administrator can turn it off; it is recorded in the audit.
delivery.bundleWarning: The bundle is the entire corpus as text: it leaves the application and may be confidential. Treat it like the project export.
delivery.notRedacted: Without redaction, the bundle contains any passwords, keys and tokens found in the documents.

agent.title: Design taxonomy with AI (agent)
agent.intro: An agent explores the documents and improves the manifest (or a template, or starts from scratch) with small changes that it checks with the rules against all the documents. It proposes; it saves nothing.
agent.warning: The agent reads the document text: it is sent to the AI service (“Agents” task).
agent.notImproves: Does not improve on the starting point
agent.load: Load the proposal into the editor
agent.loadDraft: Load the latest draft into the editor
agent.replaceBody: The agent's proposal will replace the editor text (without saving it).
agent.checkHelp: By rules, without AI and without saving: coverage and conflicts for each axis with the editor text.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.body: There are unsaved changes in the manifest or the project profile. If you leave the page, they will be lost.

leftover.title: There is a partially saved context
leftover.body: A context that did not finish saving was left in the project folder (folder “{{folder}}”), for example because the build was interrupted. Build it to complete it (it reuses that folder and replaces its contents) or delete it.

templates.title: Taxonomy templates
templates.intro: Catalogues of domains and material types for building the context. Those built into doc_organize cannot be changed: duplicate them to adapt them.
templates.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. sgi-2026). It cannot be the name of a built-in one.
templates.nameInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 64).
templates.markdownHelp: YAML front matter between --- with title, description, domains and material_types; then free-form notes.

import.unreadable: The file could not be read.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”
delete.body: Contexts already built with it do not change.

templates.nameTaken: A template with that name already exists: choose another (or edit it from the list).
templates.savedWithNotices: Template saved. Review the notices before closing.

settings.title: AI settings
settings.intro: AI services used by the instance. Whatever you save here takes precedence over the server's DOC_ORGANIZE_* variables. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again: only their last 4 characters.
settings.noEncryption: DOW_FERNET_KEYS is missing on the server: you can save the URL, the models and the document limits, but not keys.
settings.secretPlaceholder: Type a new one to change it
settings.undecryptable: There is a saved value that cannot be decrypted with the current keys: enter it again.
settings.testModelHint: Sends a minimal request to the model: it uses a few tokens.
settings.testAuthHint: Some proxies do not let the key query its own details: test the model to confirm.
settings.modelDenied: According to the server, this key has no access to the configured model.
settings.testTaskLabel: Test the model for the {{task}} task

format.json_schema: The model supports strict json_schema output.
format.json_object: The model does not support json_schema: doc_organize will use json_object and validate the response.

settings.legacy: These variables are still defined on the server but the application no longer reads them. Replace them with their equivalent or delete them:
settings.legacyRemoved: no longer used (GitHub Copilot was removed in 2.1): delete it

ownModel.dedup: Similar-content duplicate detection only works with its own model, separate from the context embeddings model, because it sends the full text of each document. Use a local model (for example bge-m3 in Ollama, alias doc-organize-dedup).

table.title: Models by feature
table.intro: Each feature uses its own model (or the proxy's recommended alias) and, optionally, its own key and budget. Click “Edit” to change them; tests use the values as typed, without saving.

litellm.title: LiteLLM connection
litellm.intro: LiteLLM Proxy for all AI features: classify, describe, design the taxonomy, agents, embeddings and duplicates by content. Each feature can have its own model, key and maximum number of documents per run; without a model it uses the proxy's recommended alias “doc-organize-<task>” (except duplicates by content, which needs its own) and without a key, the general one.

litellm_usage.title: LiteLLM usage
litellm_usage.intro: LiteLLM Proxy key whose spend is shown on the usage panel.

fields.virtual_key_taxonomy_design: Own key for designing the taxonomy
fields.budget_classify: Maximum documents to classify per run
fields.budget_enrich: Maximum documents to describe per run

usage.title: AI usage
usage.intro: What the AI spends: the spend and budget of the LiteLLM key, and what each run records (documents sent, cache and tokens). The proxy does not report the cost of each call, so the cost shown is the key's. The key's spend is cached for 5 minutes; “Refresh” fetches new data.
usage.limits: To limit how many documents the AI processes in each run:

key.title: LiteLLM key
key.help: According to the proxy (/key/info). The budget is set in LiteLLM, not here.
key.noBudget: According to the proxy (/key/info). The key has no budget in LiteLLM.

local.chartLabel_one: Input and output tokens for {{count}} day
local.chartLabel_other: Input and output tokens per day, {{count}} days
local.topRuns: Runs that used the most tokens
local.name: Name
local.empty: No AI usage recorded in this period yet.

errors.ai_auth: The service rejected the key or token. Check the AI settings.
errors.ai_connection: Could not connect to the service (or it did not respond in time).
errors.ai_error: The service returned an error or an unexpected response.
errors.ai_model: The model did not respond: check the model name or whether the key can use it.

parameters.title: AI parameters
parameters.intro: Timeouts, retries and the document cap per run. They apply without restarting. Services, models and keys are in

taskUse.classify: building the context (classifying each document on the axes)
taskUse.taxonomy_design: Taxonomy › Create or improve with AI (manifest draft)
taskUse.embed: semantic sub-phase of the context (projects with “semantic” enabled)

info.title: Information
info.intro: Read-only instance status: versions, capabilities and workers.
info.noneAliveBody: No worker has shown signs of life recently: scans and builds will stay queued until one starts.

review.title: Review classification
review.intro: What is worth checking according to the last build, most urgent first. Your decisions are saved in the project and applied in the next build, before the AI; neither the rules nor the AI change them.
review.search: Search by document name or path
review.noMatches: No document in the queue matches the search.
review.changeTitle: Set the values of an axis
review.decisionsIntro: Current project decisions (the last build applied {{applied}}).
review.notApplied: Not applied in the last build

issues.source_changed: the original has changed since the decision
issues.unknown_axis: the axis is no longer in the catalogue
issues.unknown_value: the value is no longer in the catalogue
issues.no_manifest: not applied without a manifest or template

proposals.title: Reviewer proposals (AI)
proposals.intro: An agent goes through the review queue and proposes decisions with a reason and a quote. None is applied: you accept each proposal (it is saved as your decision) or discard it. A new pass replaces pending proposals.
proposals.warning: The reviewer reads the text of the documents in the queue: it is sent to the AI service (“Agents” task).
proposals.usage: {{steps}} of {{max}} steps · {{tools}} tools · {{tokens}} tokens · {{proposals}} proposals for {{reviewed}} documents
proposals.noDocument: The document is no longer in the context.

quality.title: Classification quality
quality.intro: How accurate the classification is against a reference: a hand-labelled Excel file or the project's decisions. “Compare changes” tries another configuration without saving anything.
quality.noGold: No Excel reference: upload one below or use the project's decisions.
quality.noDecisions: The project has no current decisions to build a reference from.
quality.goldIntro: One row per document: its key (folder/path, as in “Review classification”) and, for each axis, the correct value (several separated by commas; “ninguno” if none fits; empty = unlabelled).
quality.columnsHelp: axis:column, separated by commas (e.g. domains:dominio_ok, material_types:tipo_ok).
quality.matched: {{matched}} reference documents in the context (out of {{documents}}).
quality.missing_one: {{count}} from the reference is not in the context.
quality.missing_other: {{count}} from the reference are not in the context.
quality.compareIntro: Classifies the reference documents with another template (or the manifest), another model, another AI scope or an unsaved profile, without touching the context, and compares the accuracy with that of the current context.

scopes.unclassified: What the rules do not classify

quality.profileHelp: Replaces the saved one for this test only.
quality.aiWarning: The content of the reference documents leaves the application and is sent to the AI service.

audit.title: Auditor report
audit.intro: Statistics by axis from the last build and what is worth reviewing in the catalogue (values without documents, overloaded values, low confidence…). No AI.

quality.changes_one: {{count}} value change compared with the current context
quality.changes_other: {{count}} value changes compared with the current context

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: Checks the web server environment with doc_organize: Python, docling and its models, the extras (Excel, site with a test build, audio and video), the GPU and LibreOffice. Conversion is done by the workers: their capabilities are in Information.
diagnostics.checkAiHelp: Sends a synthetic text to the classify, describe and taxonomy design models (and agents, if it has a model) and requests a vector from the embeddings model if it has its own: it uses a few tokens.
diagnostics.running: Checking… this may take a minute.
